This update for aws-nitro-enclaves-cli fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-93599: rustls-webpki: panic in `BorrowedCertRevocationList::from_der` via empty `BIT STRING`
  in `IssuingDistributionPoint` (bsc#1282250).
- CVE-2026-93600: rustls-webpki: name constraints for URI names were incorrectly accepted (bsc#1282250).
- CVE-2026-93601: rustls-webpki: name constraints were accepted for certificates asserting a wildcard name
  (bsc#1282250).
- CVE-2026-93602: rustls-webpki: CRLs not considered authoritative by Distribution Point due to faulty matching logic
  (bsc#1282250).
- GHSA-7gcf-g7xr-8hxj: serde_with: KeyValueMap serialization panics on empty sequence or map entries (bsc#1271853).

Changes for aws-nitro-enclaves-cli:

- Updated to version 1.5.2
